status: fixed behavior expectations before implementation; exact driver and timeouts must be reviewed before Apply
source: design/brief.md and the authorized supplementary validation scope

cases.expect: Cold start shows the exact menu labels, best 128, no session and a disabled Continue action.
Tapping disabled Continue leaves the initial menu unchanged.
New game creates a session and shows the static 2x2 preview with two 2 tiles, Session started. and Menu.
Menu returns to best 128 with Continue enabled and retains the created session.
Continue resumes the identical session. Evidence must prove retained identity, not merely an identical screenshot.
Without a session, opening reset then cancelling preserves best and disabled Continue; modal blocks background interaction.
Without a session, confirming reset sets best to 0 and leaves Continue disabled.
With a session, cancelling reset preserves best and the session identity; Continue remains enabled.
With a session, confirming reset sets best to 0 and Continue resumes the original session identity.
After resetting without a session, New game still creates a fresh session; best stays 0 and the modal is gone.
Android Back cancels a modal, returns from session to menu, then leaves the root menu for the system; each transition retains the appropriate data.
Home then return with the process alive restores menu, session or modal state and current values; a genuinely new process returns to the declared initial state.
A requested orientation change preserves portrait presentation, state and safe touch areas.
At font scale 1.0, all seven states have the approved text, palette, layout and resources; visible actionable areas remain inside actual system insets, at least 48 dp and non-overlapping.
At font scale 1.3, all seven states preserve scaled text, readability, safe areas and access to every required control; no glyph clipping, hidden required action or whole-screen shrinking.

The actual APK contains and uses the frozen exported icon/resource bytes and declared tokens; native accessibility exposes names, disabled state and modal scope; original device settings are restored.

proof_requirements: Freeze actual source SHA, APK digest, system image and serial before recording runtime results.
State identity must come from approved read-only observation or instrumentation, never test state injection.
Keep per-case assertions, actual screenshots for states and font variants, logs and nonzero test counts.
Failure, missing evidence, skip, cancellation, zero cases and timeout cannot count as success.
Use one actual CI normal run, one real platform failure or mandatory-step skip with blocking, and recovery; validate common input rejection in the adopted CI path.
Keep native runtime, Figma design inspection and actual human approval as separate evidence.
